description:
Goal
Update durable docs after the implementation tickets so future agents do not stitch the old machinery back in. Current docs still contain false macro readiness text and normalize some legacy follow-up/seal behavior.

Signal
northstar.html, .agent/docs/pipeline.md, .agent/docs/fact-engine.md, .agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md, .agent/docs/macro-expansion.md, and .agent/docs/telemetry.md describe one current model: product-keyed artifact demand, exact waits, no producer follow-up in artifact products, EntryCapture/IncomingInputSlot/callable/boundary products, SCC-local effects, and legacy-only status for remaining seal/transport jobs.

Strategy
Update docs from code and telemetry only after the previous tickets land. Include the 00181 proof commands and the counters that are actually meaningful. Remove or rewrite stale references to macro producers SeedRoot + BuildBackendProduct and semantic_closed as a normal artifact signal.

Removal steps
- Delete stale documentation language instead of adding caveats beside it.
- Remove examples that teach follow_up as a valid artifact producer mechanism.
- Remove or rewrite macro docs that mention SeedRoot + BuildBackendProduct producers.
- Remove references to semantic_closed.defined as a normal artifact observability signal; keep only explicitly legacy diagnostic references if still true.
- Delete any temporary plan/scaffolding docs that have been superseded by durable docs and tickets.

Verification
rg docs for stale phrases; cargo fmt --all --check if docs touch generated snippets is irrelevant but run focused tests from the parent arc; include final 00181 telemetry numbers in the ticket close comment.
title: Pull docs: make northstar and agent docs match the corrected model
